# Dylan Weber

> Portfolio of Dylan Weber, a 3D artist and graphic designer from Germany,
> specializing in game art, UI design, 3D modeling, and visual effects for
> interactive media.

## About

Dylan Weber is a 3D artist and graphic designer trained at SAE Institute
Germany. He works on game jams, UI design, and 3D assets for interactive media,
focusing on lighting, environment design, and visual effects.

## Featured Projects

- [Forgotten Lore](https://dylanweba.github.io/): Diploma final project at SAE
  Institute Bochum — a 3D recreation of the room from Edgar Allan Poe's "The
  Raven", created with three classmates.
- [CS2 Stickers](https://steamcommunity.com/id/gamerorkanik/myworkshopfiles/?p=1):
  Stickers and a spray designed for the Counter-Strike 2 Steam Workshop.
- [Blastzxne 2](https://pixum.itch.io/blastzone2): Visuals for a survivors-like
  game with minimalist geometry, made during a 2-week game jam.

## Skills

3D Modeling, Graphic Design, UI Design, Adobe Illustrator, Blender, Maya, Adobe
Creative Cloud, Unreal Engine, Substance Painter.
